name: Azor
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: Zorobabel's line runs Abiud, Eliakim, Azor, Sadoc, Achim, Eliud, Eleazar, Matthan, Jacob, and Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary; Joseph comes out of the kings, out of Solomon's kingdom.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah
